entry.title: aws/aws-sdk-net - Releases - 2026-11-12
entry.content:
4.1.1.0

4.1.1.0 (2026-11-12 19:48 UTC)

  • ACMPCA (4.1.0.1)
    • ACMPCA is now generated from its Smithy model. There are no changes to the public API.
  • AutoScaling (4.1.1.0)
    • Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling now supports ASGAverageCPUUtilizationHighResolution as a predefined metric type for target tracking scaling policies.
  • Backup (4.1.1.0)
    • Adding new notification types for SNS notifications
  • CleanRooms (4.1.1.0)
    • Adds a retry signal to protected query and protected job errors that indicates whether running the same request again might succeed, and defines error codes that identify the category of the failure.
  • CloudWatch (4.1.1.0)
    • Adds support for saving, retrieving, listing, and deleting CloudWatch metric data query definitions.
  • CloudWatchOmni (4.1.1.0)
    • Add aggregationTemporality and monotonicity to GetContextGraph MetricMetadata
  • Connect (4.1.1.0)
    • This release adds a LastModifiedTime and LastModifiedRegion field to ListIntegrationAssociations so customers can see at what time and in which Region an IntegrationAssociation was last modified in.
  • EC2 (4.1.1.0)
    • This release adds support for multiple features, including EC2 Image Builder image recipes and container recipes in AMI usage reports, Amazon EC2 Detailed Monitoring adds opt-in metrics, and Global Accelerator and API Gateway V2 as resource exclusions for VPC Encryption Control.
  • EMRContainers (4.1.1.0)
    • This release updates range of maxInQueueDepth and maxConcurrency limit from 10000 to 1000.
  • GameLiftStreams (4.1.1.0)
    • Adds support for ApplicationStartedAt on stream sessions, a timestamp that indicates when the application launched for the stream session, returned by GetStreamSession and StartStreamSession. Also added streamingStartedAt and streamingEndedAt.
  • GuardDuty (4.1.1.0)
    • Adds the ListInvestigationRecords API, which returns the step-by-step records of a completed investigation. Adds investigation scope details and an optional structured summary to GetInvestigation. Adds filter criteria and investigation type to ListInvestigations.
  • ImportExport (Removed)
    • AWS Import/Export has been removed from the SDK because it has been discontinued.
  • Lightsail (4.1.1.0)
    • Amazon Lightsail now offers web addresses, so you can quickly make a website or application reachable at a name like mysite.amazonlightsail.com. A web address is free while attached to a Lightsail CDN, with no domain to register and no SSL TLS certificate to create or renew.
  • MediaConnect (4.1.1.0)
    • MediaConnect adds four features. (1) RTMP Push on Router Input and Flows (RTMP, RTMPS, eRTMP). (2) PID Remapping on Router rewrites PIDs inline without transcoding. (3) Key Frame Switching transitions router inputs on video boundaries. (4) SRT Merge Input bonds redundant SRT streams.
  • MediaLive (4.1.1.0)
    • AWS Elemental MediaLive now adds a caption language setting for MediaPackage V2 output groups that signals a stream carries no closed captions.
  • MediaTailor (4.1.1.0)
    • Add post origin manifest hook, add HLS tag processor
  • MobileAnalytics (Removed)
    • Amazon Mobile Analytics has been removed from the SDK because it has been discontinued.
  • MWAA (4.1.1.0)
    • Amazon MWAA now supports Airflow environments with IAM Identity Center (IDC) integration and exposes OSS Airflow Multi-Team feature. Users can configure individual IDC-backed identities and fine-grained authorization, and define Dags on per-team basis.
  • MWAAServerless (4.1.1.0)
    • Adds support for Airflow UI in MWAA Serverless
  • Odb (4.1.1.0)
    • ODB now supports scaling for Exadata Dedicated offerings. Customers can scale database and storage servers on Exadata infrastructure, resize VM clusters and Autonomous VM clusters, and add or remove virtual machines in a VM cluster.
  • Route53 (4.1.1.0)
    • Amazon Route 53 now supports Record Set Protection, which blocks changes to protected records in a hosted zone.
  • SageMaker (4.1.1.0)
    • Adds CreatedBy and LastModifiedBy to the DescribeHub and DescribeHubContent responses and to HubContent records returned by the Search API, identifying the IAM identity or SageMaker Studio user profile that created or last modified a hub or hub content.
  • SecretsManager (4.1.1.0)
    • Adds support for cross-account replication with the new AssociateCrossAccountReplica, DisassociateCrossAccountReplica, and ListResourcePolicies APIs, CrossAccountPrimaryARN in CreateSecret, cross-account replication status in DescribeSecret, and PolicyName in the resource policy APIs.
  • SecurityAgent (4.1.1.0)
    • Adds support for cleanup strategy in CreatePentestInput and UpdatePentestInput.
  • SSOAdmin (4.1.1.0)
    • Adds support for Network Controls on IAM Identity Center instances. You can now require that access to your instance and AWS managed applications originate from VPC endpoints in your organization, and optionally narrow that perimeter to specific VPCs, IP ranges, or application exceptions.

4.1.0.0

4.1.0.0 (2026-11-11 23:14 UTC)

  • S3 (4.1.0.0)
    • Fixed a bug where TransferUtility.Download/DownloadAsync (the non-multipart path) always waited 100ms after a successful download. The backoff delay now only applies before an actual retry, and the async path uses a non-blocking await instead of a blocking Thread.Sleep.
  • Extensions.CborProtocol (4.1.0.0)
    • Added Smithy RPC v2 CBOR support for the byte, short, bigInteger and bigDecimal types (Full Numeric Type Support specification): byte and short as CBOR integers, bigInteger as a bignum (tags 2/3) and bigDecimal as a decimal fraction (tag 4) via the new CborWriterExtensions.WriteBigDecimal.
  • Extensions.Numerics (4.1.0.0)
    • Breaking Change: The assembly now has AssemblyVersion 4.0.0.0 and AssemblyFileVersion 4.0.0.x. Version 4.0.0.2 shipped with 0.0.0.0 because the project was missing Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs, so the version from _sdk-versions.json was never applied.
  • Core 4.1.0.0
    • Added AWS4aSigner class that implements SigV4a signing in managed code. AWS CRT is no longer used by the SDK for this purpose, and the related APIs were deprecated.
    • Added build targets for .NET 10 and .NET 11
    • Added support for the byte, short, bigInteger and bigDecimal model types (Full Numeric Type Support specification): byte maps to sbyte, short to short, bigInteger to System.Numerics.BigInteger and bigDecimal to Amazon.Extensions.Numerics.BigDecimal, serialized without losing digits or scale.
    • AWSSDK.Core now depends on AWSSDK.Extensions.Numerics, which provides BigDecimal.
    • Breaking Change: Removed support .NET Core 3.1
    • Fixed a buffer overflow in ChunkedUploadWrapperStream when an encrypting stream is uploaded with a buffer size that does not divide the chunk size, and reduced the per-chunk allocations of chunked uploads.
    • Reduce CPU and memory used by checksums and chunked uploads: stop allocating per 64-byte block in the managed MD5 used to validate GetObject responses, size aws-chunked upload buffers to small payloads, stop allocating a temporary buffer per read when sending trailing checksums, and compute CRC32 with a faster slicing-by-16 implementation on targets where System.IO.Hashing is not vectorized (.NET 8, .NET Standard and .NET Framework).
    • Replace checksum provider from the native Amazon Common Runtime to System.IO.Hashing
    • All service and extension packages updated to require new Core

entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-11-12
entry.content:
Azure.ResourceManager.Compute.Recommender_1.1.0-beta.3

1.1.0-beta.3 (2026-11-12)

Features Added

  • Upgraded API version to 2026-10-05-preview.
  • Added regular compute placement scoring through GetComputePlacementScores(AzureLocation), which requires the scoring location. The new request and result models expose zonal scope as IsZonal.
  • Added ComputeRecommenderPlacementScore.PlacementPreference.

Other Changes

  • Upgraded Azure.Core from 1.62.0 to 1.64.0.

Azure.Security.KeyVault.Secrets_4.13.0-beta.1

4.13.0-beta.1 (2026-11-11)

Other Changes

  • Updated the Azure.Core dependency to 1.65.0, which includes the MSAL 4.92.0 update.

Azure.Security.KeyVault.Certificates_4.11.0-beta.1

4.11.0-beta.1 (2026-11-11)

Breaking Changes

  • Removed CertificateClientOptions.ServiceVersion.V2026_03_01_Preview. Use V2026_04_01 instead.

Bugs Fixed

  • Preserved the service version value shipped for 2026-04-01 in version 4.10.0.

Other Changes

  • Updated the Azure.Core dependency to 1.65.0, which includes the MSAL 4.92.0 update.

Azure.ResourceManager.RedisEnterprise_1.5.0-beta.1

1.5.0-beta.1 (2026-11-11)

Features Added

  • Updated the default service API version to 2026-10-01-preview.
  • Added cluster firewall rules for Azure Managed Redis. Use an empty array to clear rules; omit firewallRules on PATCH to leave them unchanged unless public network access is disabled.
  • Reintroduced custom Redis ACL access strings and provisioning error details to access policy assignments, previously available in 1.4.0-beta.2 but not in 1.4.0.

Azure.Provisioning.AppContainers_1.3.0

1.3.0 (2026-11-11)

Features Added

  • Upgraded api-version to 2026-07-01.
  • Added support for Container App private endpoint connections, Azure Functions, Dapr component resiliency policies, .NET components, label history, sandbox groups, and sandbox group virtual network connections.
  • Added support for managed environment migration eligibility checks and OpenTelemetry configuration.

Bugs Fixed

  • Corrected default names for Container Apps managed environments to use 2–60 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens.
    Expect automatically generated managed environment names to change when upgrading if explicit names are not set.

Other Changes

  • Migrated library generation to the TypeSpec provisioning emitter.

Azure.ResourceManager.Sovereign_1.0.0-beta.1

1.0.0-beta.1 (2026-11-11)

Features Added

This is the first preview release of the Microsoft Azure Sovereign management client library for .NET, generated from TypeSpec with API version 2026-10-31-preview.

  • Added SovereignViewResource and SovereignViewCollection to manage Sovereign views.
  • Added the CheckSovereignNameAvailability and CheckSovereignNameAvailabilityLocal operations.

Bugs Fixed

  • Expose RemediationId when a successful remediation long-running operation returns its action result in the ARM properties envelope. Flat responses and standard ARM polling, cancellation, and failure handling are unchanged.

4.9.0-beta.5 (2026-11-11)

Other Changes

  • Updated the Azure.Core dependency to 1.65.0, which includes the MSAL 4.92.0 update.

4.11.0-beta.6 (2026-11-11)

  • Updated the Azure.Core dependency to 1.65.0, which includes the MSAL 4.92.0 update.

1.1.0-beta.1 (2026-09-03)

entry.title: mysql-net/MySqlConnector - Releases - 2026-11-12
entry.content:
3.0.0

  • Support .NET 11.
    • Support zstd compression on .NET 11: #717.
    • With UseCompression=True, zstd is preferred over zlib if the server supports it.
  • Possibly Breaking Remove .NET 6.0 and .NET 9.0 target frameworks.
    • Microsoft ended .NET 6.0 support on 12 November 2024 and .NET 9.0 support on 10 November 2026.
    • The minimum supported version of .NET is now .NET 8.0; .NET 9.0 applications will use the net8.0 build.
    • .NET 6.0 and .NET 7.0 applications should still work via netstandard2.1, but won't have DbBatch integration or DateOnly/TimeOnly support.
  • Possibly Breaking Remove .NET Framework 4.6.2 integration tests.
    • MySqlConnector still targets net462 as the minimum supported .NET Framework version but the integration tests for it have been removed and no longer run on each CI build.
    • .NET Framework 4.6.2 will be unsupported on 12 January 2027 and we advise users to upgrade to a supported version.
  • Breaking Remove experimental OpenTelemetry semantic conventions: #1435.
    • Only the stable database semantic conventions are emitted; the OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN environment variable is ignored.
    • MySqlConnectorTracingOptionsBuilder.WithSemanticConventionsKinds is now [Obsolete] and has no effect.
    • The legacy db.connection_string, db.name, db.statement, db.system, db.user, net.*, and thread.id tags and the exception event are no longer recorded.
    • Open activities now have db.namespace and server.address tags even if the connection fails.
    • A command timeout sets error.type to timeout.
  • Possibly Breaking VARBINARY(16) columns are no longer read as Guid when using Binary16 GuidFormat: #1691.
    • A workaround is to call MySqlDataReader.GetGuid instead of GetValue.
  • Possibly Breaking Update dependencies to avoid binding redirects on .NET Framework: #1674.
  • Possibly Breaking When a pooled connection's database was changed (with ChangeDatabase or USE), select the connection string's Database again without reauthenticating: #1671.
    • This avoids calling ProvidePasswordCallback and saves round trips when pipelining is enabled.
    • With ConnectionReset=False, other session state is no longer reset in this case.
  • Possibly Breaking Set isolation level for XA transactions from TransactionScope: #1299.
    • XA transactions that don't specify an isolation level now use SERIALIZABLE instead of the server default.
  • Possibly Breaking Changed several columns in the tables schema from long to ulong; this matches the data type on most MySQL servers.
  • Add MySqlDataSource.Clear and MySqlDataSource.ClearAsync: #1670.
  • Return true from MySqlTransaction.SupportsSavepoints: #1676.
  • Use a plugin registered with AuthenticationPlugins.Register when the server switches to an authentication method that MySqlConnector doesn't implement: #1678.
  • Use performance_schema.processlist for the ProcessList schema with MySQL 8.0.22 and later: #1443.
  • Remove proxy detection for retired Azure Database for MySQL Single Server: #1661.
  • Identify the column in InvalidCastException messages: #1135.
  • Respect NoBackslashEscapes for binary GUID parameters: #1692.
  • Fix DnsCheckInterval so new connections use the pool's cached DNS addresses, instead of possibly reconnecting to the old IP address after a DNS change: #1666.
  • Fix prepared statement executing against the wrong database: #1684.
  • Fix DbType.Object being mapped to MySqlDbType.Vector: #1679.
  • Fix error status not being recorded on Execute activity: #1667.
  • Fix Parameter '@'%'' must be defined. when executing account management statements: #1480.
  • Optimization: Read typed values (e.g., GetInt32, GetDateTime) without boxing: #721.
  • Optimization: Reduce lock contention when resetting the command timeout for each row: #1290.
  • Optimization: Reuse a cached buffer for large packets: #1686.
  • Optimization: Use runtime async, ZLibEncoder, and ZLibDecoder in .NET 11.
  • Thanks to @alaricd, @birdnamoo, @eriawan, @rodri-oliveira-dev, and @VerstraeteNick for contributions to this release.
